headlines.headline: FLORIDA TOPS PRESEASON TOP 25 AS MICHIGAN AND UCONN OPEN NEW ERAS WITH TIP-OFF THREE WEEKS AWAY
headlines.detail: ESPN's preseason Top 25 projects Florida at No. 1 (KenPom favors Duke); reigning champ Michigan and runner-up UConn both face heavy roster turnover. AP's official preseason poll is not yet out.

headlines.headline: LAKERS' RECORD $12 BILLION SALE CLOSES AS LUKA DONCIC SITS OUT INDEFINITELY
headlines.detail: ESPN reports the Lakers' ownership sale closed at a record $12B NBA valuation. Luka Doncic is out indefinitely per coach JJ Redick; LeBron James is reportedly managing chronic arthritis. NBA Cup group play begins Oct. 30 with Lakers at Warriors.

headlines.headline: 49ERS STAY UNBEATEN AT 5-0; SEAHAWKS GET QUICK TURNAROUND AT BRONCOS THURSDAY
headlines.detail: San Francisco rallied to beat Seattle 32-29 Sunday, improving to 5-0 and dropping the Seahawks to 3-2. Seattle visits Denver Thursday, Oct. 15, 8:15 p.m. ET (TNF); both teams wear throwbacks.

headlines.headline: GEORGIA HOLDS NO. 1 IN AP POLL AS HUSKIES DROP TO 3-3 AHEAD OF FRIDAY AT PURDUE
headlines.detail: Georgia (6-0) stays No. 1 ahead of Notre Dame, Miami, Ohio State and Indiana; Texas and Oregon keep sliding. Washington (3-3, 0-3 Big Ten) lost big to Iowa and visits Purdue Friday, Oct. 16 — UW's first trip there since 1990.
